name: Fate Thread
description: Follow the thread from a foe's last harm to the fate that waits at its end.

name: Chosen Spark
description: Throw a spark that has already been fated to land where the foe will stand.

name: Destined Step
description: Step to the one place where fate says a blow will miss.

name: Fate Knot
description: Tie the thread of a foe's fate in a knot that holds their feet to the ground.

name: Cause Beam
description: Fire a beam that strikes the foe as the sure effect of a cause they set in motion.

name: Fated Guard
description: Turn a blow aside along a path where it was fated to fall short.

name: Fated Return
description: Return every harm in the field to its doer by the path that fate has already laid.

name: Cause Lock
description: Lock a foe's next action behind the cause that must come before it.

name: Binding Destiny
description: Bind a foe to the destiny their deeds have earned and press down their qi with its weight.

name: Fated Reckoning
description: streams: Karma + Fate; Bind the foe's coming fate to the harm they have done so that their next hour brings that harm home.

name: Hour Glance
description: Glance at a foe and feel how long their last wrong has gone unpaid.

name: Late Spark
description: Throw a spark that lands a moment after it should and stings the heavier for the wait.

name: Instant Step
description: Step into the gap between one heartbeat of the foe and the next.

name: Hour Debt
description: Let a debt grow on the foe's qi with every hour and press down more heavily each time.

name: Aged Wrong
description: Strike with a wrong long left unpaid so that the blow pierces with its full age.

name: Elapsed Guard
description: Hold a guard that grows stronger with each hour it has stood.

name: Interest Hour
description: Strike with the added weight of every hour since the wrong was done.

name: Aged Return
description: Return old harms to all who did them with the force that the years have given.

name: Hours Bind
description: Bind a foe to a wrong of many hours past and hold them in its grip.

name: Hours Due
description: Call due every hour of a long-unpaid wrong in one strike that no guard can blunt.

name: Compounded Hour
description: streams: Karma + Time; Let the interest of a wrong compound until a single hour holds all the harm of many years.
